trader_upgrade_text:uns_lore.text:
Universal-Network Scouting System.
Uses UN data, analysis and inference
to reveal enemy unit information.

trader_upgrade_text:uns_effect.text:
All enemy units start with
Scan applied.

trader_upgrade_text:zci_lore.text:
Z-Chip Interchange System.
Extends $$ジェニオン$$'s Z-Chip collection across
the battlefield, though efficiency is low.

trader_upgrade_text:zci_effect.text:
At stage clear, gain 5 Z Chips
per enemy unit shot down.

trader_upgrade_text:dme_effect.text:
On clear: funds = damage dealt
to enemies this stage / 20.

trader_upgrade_text:teu_lore.text:
Tension Energy Up System.
Hangar sounds, scents and sights lift spirits.
Relaxation tech repurposed for battle.

trader_upgrade_text:teu_effect.text:
On deployment: teams +1 Tag
Tension; allied pilots +5 Focus.
